persona_lines.sage: Breathe. The urge is a weather system. Let it pass over you.
persona_lines.coach: Breathe. Four in, four hold, six out. Go.
persona_lines.grace: Breathe with me. Slow. You're not alone in this.
persona_lines.sunny: Big slow breath. Like you're smelling soup. In… and out.
persona_lines.brother: Just breathe for a sec, man. Nothing else.

persona_lines.sage: Put the phone somewhere you'd have to walk to.
persona_lines.coach: Phone face down. Other room. Move.
persona_lines.grace: Set the phone down for a moment. Let your hands rest.
persona_lines.sunny: Phone goes night-night. Face down. Bye bye.

persona_lines.sage: Stand up. Change the posture, change the thought.
persona_lines.coach: Up. On your feet. Shoulders back.
persona_lines.grace: Stand up for a moment. Let your body lead.
persona_lines.sunny: Up up up! Shake it out like a wet dog.
persona_lines.brother: Get up, man. Sitting there isn't helping.

persona_lines.sage: Leave the room. Urges are tied to places.
persona_lines.coach: Different room. Lights on. Two minutes.
persona_lines.grace: Walk into another room. Sometimes a new space is all it takes.
persona_lines.brother: Go to the kitchen. Different room, different head.

title: Shower
lines: Cold if you can manage it.

persona_lines.sage: A cold shower interrupts everything. That's the point.
persona_lines.grace: A shower can be a reset. Let the water do the work.
persona_lines.sunny: Cold shower! Scream a little. It's allowed.
persona_lines.brother: Cold shower, man. You'll hate me for 30 seconds then thank me.

title: Walk
lines: Leave the phone in your pocket.

persona_lines.sage: Walk. Movement clears what thinking cannot.
persona_lines.grace: Take a short walk. Talk to God on the way if you like.
persona_lines.sunny: Walk time! Look at a tree. Judge a cloud.
persona_lines.brother: Go for a quick walk. Round the block. I'll wait.

title: Pray
lines: Sit in the quiet for a minute.

persona_lines.sage: If you pray, pray now. If you don't, sit in silence.
persona_lines.coach: Take it to God. Two minutes. Then move.
persona_lines.grace: Would you pray with me? Just honest words. He already knows.
persona_lines.sunny: Quick chat with the Big Guy. He's a good listener.
persona_lines.brother: Say a prayer, man. Doesn't have to be fancy.

persona_lines.sage: Push-ups. Give the energy somewhere to go.
persona_lines.coach: Drop. Max set. Then ten more. Now.
persona_lines.grace: Move your body. Push-ups, squats, anything.
persona_lines.brother: Push-ups till you're shaking. Then we talk.

persona_lines.sage: Drink a glass of water. Slowly.
persona_lines.coach: Full glass of water. Drink it all.
persona_lines.grace: Get a glass of water. Small acts of care matter.
persona_lines.brother: Go drink some water. Yeah, really.

title: Contact someone
lines: You don't have to explain why.

persona_lines.sage: Message someone. Being seen changes the moment.
persona_lines.grace: Reach out to someone you trust. You were never meant to fight alone.
persona_lines.sunny: Text a friend something silly. Instant reset.
persona_lines.brother: Hit up a mate. Even just 'you up?'

persona_lines.sage: Write one honest sentence about what you're feeling.
persona_lines.coach: One sentence. What's really going on? Write it.
persona_lines.grace: Write down what's heavy. Then give it away.
persona_lines.brother: Type out what's actually up. No one's reading it but you.

persona_lines.sage: Don't decide anything yet. Give me ten minutes.
persona_lines.coach: Ten minutes. Timer's on. No decisions.
persona_lines.grace: Give it ten minutes. Waves pass.
persona_lines.sunny: Ten minutes! I'll be here. Let's outlast it.
persona_lines.brother: Give me ten, man. Just ten.
